English: to fall in love at first sight
Example Sentence: 처음에 그를 봤을 때 나는 첫눈에 사랑에 빠졌다.
Sentence Translation: When I first saw him I fell in love at first sight.

Example Sentence: 그렇게 시간이 흘러 여름 방학이 다가왔다.
Sentence Translation: As time went by like that, summer vacation approached.

English: to decide that one must definitely do something
Example Sentence: 내일 그 여자와 얘기해야겠다고 결심을 했어요.
Sentence Translation: I decided that I must talk with that girl tomorrow.

Example Sentence: 나는 용기를 내고 그의 수업이 있는 교실에서 기다렸다.
Sentence Translation: I mustered my courage and waited in the classroom where his class was.

English: to feel like one is flying (on cloud nine)
Etymology: 하늘 (sky) + -을 (object marker) + 날다 (to fly) + -ㄹ 것 같은 (feeling like) + 기분 (mood)
Example Sentence: 민호가 나에게 밥을 먹자고 했다! 하늘을 날 것 같은 기분이었다.
Sentence Translation: Minho asked me to eat! I felt like I was flying in the sky.

Example Sentence: 나는 최대한 내 기쁜 마음을 감추려고 노력했다.
Sentence Translation: I tried my best to hide my happy feelings.

English: to start a conversation/strike up a talk
Example Sentence: 처음에 네가 나에게 말을 걸었을 때 얼마나 기뻤는지 몰라.
Sentence Translation: I don't know how happy I was when you first started a conversation with me.

Etymology: 좋은 (good) + 추억 (memory) + -을 (object marker) + 쌓다 (to stack/pile up)
Example Sentence: 현재 나는 민호와 하루하루를 좋은 추억을 쌓으면서 행복하게 지내고 있다.
Sentence Translation: Currently I am living happily with Minho building good memories day by day.

Example Sentence: 그것은 맛이 없을 뿐만 아니라 비싸요.
Sentence Translation: Not only is that thing not delicious, but it is expensive.

English: not only a precious friend but also...
Etymology: 소중하다 (to be precious) + 친구 (friend) + 이다 (to be) + -ㄹ 뿐만 아니라 (not only... but also)
Example Sentence: 민호는 나에게 아주 소중한 친구일 뿐만 아니라 애인이다.
Sentence Translation: Not only is Minho a precious friend, but also my boyfriend.
